name: Rail safety and access
what: Be accredited by the national rail safety regulator and negotiate track access under national or state access regimes.

layers.who: Office of the National Rail Safety Regulator (accreditation)
State access regulator or ACCC (track access)

basis.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
basis.quote: Have IPART review the NSW Rail Access Undertaking, including its interaction with the national rail access regime
